name: Xiang Yu
role: Chu general, later Hegemon-King of Western Chu
known_facts: Born to a military family of the state of Chu and rose in the revolt against Qin
Destroyed the main Qin army at Julu in 207 BCE after cutting off his own retreat
Titled himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu and partitioned the empire into eighteen kingdoms
Routed Liu Bang's much larger coalition at Pengcheng in 205 BCE according to the Shiji
Was encircled at Gaixia and died near the Wu River in 202 BCE at about thirty
interpretation: Late-Qin / early-Han Chinese commander, based on the user reference.
unknowns: Later drama and legend embellish much of his biography beyond the Shiji account
